sample_unit: adult patients (two-hour vital sign trend images)

links.outcome: VLM triage acuity agreement with attending physician and under-triage rate
links.effect: VLM assigned same acuity category as attending physician in 75% of cases and underestimated acuity in 7%, compared with 14% underestimation by the physician in training.
links.quote: The VLM assigned the same patient acuity category as attending physician in 75 % of cases and underestimated acuity in 7 % of cases, compared with 14 % underestimation by the physician in training.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic and triage agreement of a vision-language model (Gemini 2.5 Flash) on vital sign trend images compared to physician assessments without testing an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
